turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you comfortable with how I am speaking?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Please talk a bit slower, my hearing is poor.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I came because of my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What kind of sensation is it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel it in your left arm or in your jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I missed that, can you repeat it?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: No problem, I will repeat it more slowly. Does it move into your arms or up toward your neck?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I feel it in my jaw sometimes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It came on slowly last night.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only when I hurry.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Will I have to stay in the hospital?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Not necessarily. We will decide after we see your test results.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you taken anything for it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I took an antacid and it did not do anything.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel winded along with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No trouble breathing at all.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you felt faint or dizzy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you been sweating with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has a parent or sibling had a heart attack?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My brother had bypass surgery.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Let me ask about risk factors: tobacco, blood pressure, diabetes, cholesterol.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure. I quit smoking years ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you had any procedure on your heart before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: They put a small tube in my heart artery some years back.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Which pills do you take regularly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Clopidogrel and Lisinopril.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: To finish, here is the plan. First, bring your medicine bottles to your next visit. Second, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Can you repeat the plan in your own words for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will bring my medicine bottles next time and get the heart tracing and the blood test today.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any other questions before you go?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: All right, we are done. Take care of yourself.
